title: Gillager News
statementMd:
Gason and his bestie Gteve love the letter 'G', and they successfully hacked into the Villager News' director's computer where the director stores all of the news headlines to be broadcasted. Since Gason loves the letter 'G' so much, he decides to **replace the first character** of every single headline with the *uppercase* letter 'G'! Now Gason is watching the Villager News (with Gteve) and is wondering how many headlines he modified made it into the actual news broadcast.

Given the initial headlines stored on the news director's computer and the final headlines which were actually broadcasted, determine how many headlines in the news broadcast were those possibly modified by Gason and Gteve.

Everything is **case-sensitive**!!!

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $1\leq n\leq 110$, the number of initial news headlines on the news director's computer.

The next $n$ lines each contain a single string $s_i$: the $i^{th}$ headline stored on the news director's computer before Gason's modification ($1\leq |s_i| \leq 67$). It is guaranteed that the $s_i$'s are distinct.

The next line contains a single integer $1\leq m \leq 111$, the number of headlines which were broadcasted on the Villager News.

The last $m$ lines each contain a single string $t_i$: the $i^{th}$ headline broadcasted on the Villager News ($1\leq |t_i| \leq 67$). It is guaranteed that the $t_i$'s are distinct.

Every single character in each string is **alphanumeric** or an **underscore**.

## Output

Output a single integer, the number of headlines in the Villager News broadcast which could have been modified by Gason and Gteve.

*We have provided sample input parsing scripts in C++, Java, and Python below for the first two problems.*

- C++: [https://pastebin.com/8A0YWdcx](https://pastebin.com/8A0YWdcx)
- Java: [https://pastebin.com/8suZZsMK](https://pastebin.com/8suZZsMK)
- Python: [https://pastebin.com/W2MkdBx9](https://pastebin.com/W2MkdBx9)
statementZhMd:
Gason 和他的好友 Gteve 都喜欢字母“G”。他们成功入侵了 Villager News 主编的电脑，主编会在电脑中存储所有即将播出的新闻标题。由于 Gason 非常喜欢字母“G”，他决定将每一条新闻标题的**第一个字符**替换为*大写*字母“G”！现在，Gason 正和 Gteve 一起观看 Villager News，并想知道有多少条经过他修改的新闻标题最终出现在了实际播出的新闻中。

给定新闻主编电脑中存储的初始新闻标题，以及实际播出的最终新闻标题，请确定新闻中有多少条标题可能是由 Gason 和 Gteve 修改过的。

所有内容都**区分大小写**！

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $1\leq n\leq 110$，表示新闻主编电脑中存储的初始新闻标题数量。

接下来的 $n$ 行中，每行包含一个字符串 $s_i$：Gason 修改前，存储在新闻主编电脑中的第 $i$ 条新闻标题（$1\leq |s_i| \leq 67$）。保证所有 $s_i$ 互不相同。

接下来一行包含一个整数 $1\leq m \leq 111$，表示在 Villager News 中播出的新闻标题数量。

最后 $m$ 行中，每行包含一个字符串 $t_i$：Villager News 播出的第 $i$ 条新闻标题（$1\leq |t_i| \leq 67$）。保证所有 $t_i$ 互不相同。

每个字符串中的每个字符都是**字母、数字或下划线**。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示 Villager News 播出的新闻中可能被 Gason 和 Gteve 修改过的标题数量。

*对于前两道题，我们在下方提供了 C++、Java 和 Python 的样例输入解析脚本。*

- Python: [https://pastebin.com/W2MkdBx9](https://pastebin.com/W2MkdBx9)
